import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Filter out rows where PRODUCTLINE or SALES is missing or SALES is not a number
df_filtered = df[df['PRODUCTLINE'].notna() & df['SALES'].notna()]

# Convert SALES to numeric (in case of string), coercing errors to NaN, then drop NaN
df_filtered['SALES'] = pd.to_numeric(df_filtered['SALES'], errors='coerce')
df_filtered = df_filtered[df_filtered['SALES'].notna()]

# Group by PRODUCTLINE and sum SALES
result = df_filtered.groupby('PRODUCTLINE', as_index=False)['SALES'].sum()

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_59/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
